mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_interaction (target_type, target_id, user_id, action_type, reason, status, create_time) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{userId}, #{actionType}, #{reason}, COALESCE(#{status}, 1), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE -- 重复交互时只更新理由与状态，不新增行（依赖 uk_interaction 唯一键） reason = VALUES(reason), status = COALESCE(VALUES(status), status)
mapper.select: SELECT target_id FROM content_interaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND action_type = 'FAVORITE' AND target_type = 'NEWS' ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ci.id AS id, ci.user_id AS user_id, ci.target_id AS post_id, NULL AS reply_id, ci.reason AS reason, ci.status AS status, ci.create_time AS create_time, ci.update_time AS update_time FROM content_interaction ci WHERE ci.action_type = 'REPORT' AND ci.status = #{status} ORDER BY ci.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE content_interaction SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND action_type = 'REPORT'
